as_told.title: Raytheon triangle and holographic craft at Fort Irwin

plain: Steven Greer, author of a book called Disclosure: An Illustrated History, shows on Jesse Michels's podcast what he calls the Raytheon triangle, a triangle-shaped craft he says was built by Raytheon, a US weapons maker, and seen at Fort Irwin, an Army base in California, based on what a witness told him. In a later episode he adds that the craft could make holograms and might be used to fake an alien invasion. He also says the witness and his wife were later abducted by the craft.
